Implementation Plan

I have what I need. Summary of what the reads showed:

- **Module location conflict:** `.codex-workflow-src` is under `GITHUB_WORKSPACE`, so the wrapper would refuse it (`module_untrusted`). The module has to be copied into the run dir before the editor runs.
- **Container setup gaps:** the wrapper starts docker with `env -i` and no `--env`. The repo vars never reach the container, and the deps venv isn't mounted where it works (`/opt/codex-venv`).
- **Untrusted output:** the container's `summary.md` is written into an rw mount the tests control, so it can't go into the PR body as-is.

Writing the plan.

# Implementation plan: P3 of `docs/plans/prepush-affected-test-gate-plan.md` (implement gate and one repair turn)

PLANNING REF CONTEXT: HEAD `1534d40a3533ce9b7778a8d5e58dbe8866abe689` on `orchestrator/project-8188` (integration branch metadata `orchestrator/project-8188`, mismatch `false`).

## §20.E automation surface
- **Scripts:** one new step script, `scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh`. It is sourced by a new `implement.yml` step and also has an `expected-files` subcommand. Two existing scripts get small additive extensions: `scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh` and `scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh`.
- **Entry point:** `.github/workflows/implement.yml`, trigger `issue_comment` `/approved`. The new step "Pre-push affected-test gate" runs between "Enforce syntax validation outcome" and "Commit changes".
- **Supervisor:** none needed. The step runs inside the existing implement job.
- **Database work:** none.
- **Removal registry:** one `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry for the new step script (type `long-running`, removal trigger `permanent — review annually`).

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends `scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh`
Scope-mode justification: The issue spells out one production-safe PR, and every behaviour in it is implemented as written. Three reads above change how some of it has to be done:
- the wrapper refuses a module inside the workspace, and `.codex-workflow-src` is inside it;
- the wrapper passes no `--env` and no usable venv mount;
- the container's `summary.md` can be written by the tests.

Fixing these needs about 25 additive lines in the P1 wrapper and an additive `image` action in `codex_isolated_exec.sh`. That stays under the Boil-the-Lake threshold (≤30 LOC, no new dependency or external interface). It is picked over shipping a gate that would always report `module_untrusted` or `pytest_unavailable`, because completeness ranks above speed under §6. Everything else reuses existing pieces:
- the post-Codex syntax-repair loop pattern (prompt layout, `codex_thread_reuse.sh direct-run` launch, stray rollback);
- the staged-support restore/reinstall helper;
- `targeted_file_context.extract_paths_from_plan`;
- the gate module's own `select` and `write_summary`.

## Functions or modules to implement

### 1. `scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh`
- **Dockerfile** in `write_image_context`, the shared codex block: extend the apt line with `shellcheck`. Add `RUN python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages ruff==0.17.2`.
  - `--break-system-packages` is needed because Debian bookworm marks the system Python as externally managed (PEP 668).
  - `ci.yml` installs ruff unpinned (lines 218 and 555), so the latest release is the "same major" (0.x). The deps venv is created with `--system-site-packages`, so ruff stays visible inside it.
- **New action `image`:** add `image` to the action `case` list and the usage string. It runs `build_image` (engine `codex`) and prints the image ref, with no other side effect. It honours `CODEX_ISOLATED_IMAGE_BUILD_ATTEMPTS`. Before adding it, run `grep -rIF "codex_isolated_exec.sh image"` to confirm the name is unused.
- **Publishing:** no edit needed. `scripts/sandbox_images_publish.sh` already mirrors this image by calling `codex_isolated_exec.sh image-context` (lines 51-54), so the Dockerfile text is part of the input hash, and `publish-sandbox-images.yml` already lists `scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh` in its `paths:`.

### 2. `scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh` (additive only; existing flags and behaviour unchanged)
- **`--venv DIR`:** when given and it resolves to a directory, mount it read-only at `/opt/codex-venv`, which is where `prepare --deps` builds it. Add `--env PATH=/opt/codex-venv/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin` and `--env HOME=/tmp`.
- **`--shards N` and `--large-file-tests N`:** accept digits only; anything else is logged `outcome=config_invalid` and dropped. Forward them as `--shards` on the `run` command line and `--env PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_LARGE_FILE_TESTS=N`.
- **Why the change is needed:** today the container gets no runner environment at all, so these repo vars never reach the module. And a venv mounted at its host path through `--deps-root` breaks its absolute shebangs.

### 3. `scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` (new; tabs; mode 0755; header comment naming the step and issue)

It has two entry modes:
- **Sourced with no arguments** (gate step): runs `implement_prepush_test_gate_main`.
- **Executed as `expected-files PLAN_FILE ISSUE_BODY_FILE`** (context step): prints the advisory section.

Helper functions (verify uniqueness with `grep -rIF` first):
- `implement_prepush_test_gate_log`: prints `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE phase=implement key=value…` to stderr.
- `implement_prepush_test_gate_mode`:
  - reads `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE` (default `repair`), lowercases it, accepts `off|report|repair`;
  - any other value logs `outcome=mode_invalid` and becomes `repair`;
  - `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES`, `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_LARGE_FILE_TESTS` and `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_SHARDS` default to `15`, `50` and `4` inside the script (unattended §8).
- `implement_prepush_test_gate_locate`: resolves the module, wrapper and repair template.
  - First choice: the pre-editor run-dir copies (`${IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR}/prepush_affected_tests.py`, `.../prepush_test_gate_run.sh`, `${IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR%/scripts}/prompts/mode-implement-repair-tests.txt`).
  - Fallback: `${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-workflow-src/{workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/…,scripts/…,prompts/…}`, copied into `${RUNTIME_DIR}/prepush_gate_support/`, which is outside the workspace.
  - Only regular, non-symlink files are accepted.
  - Missing module or wrapper: log `outcome=skipped reason=module_absent` and return. Missing template in `repair` mode: run as `report` and log `reason=repair_template_absent`.
  - The PR checkout's copies are never read.
- `implement_prepush_test_gate_run_once <out_dir>`:
  - gets the image from `bash "${RUN_DIR}/codex_isolated_exec.sh" image` (a failure gives a synthetic `unverified reason=image_unavailable` result);
  - calls the wrapper with `--worktree "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" --module … --image … --base "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --out-dir <out_dir> --timeout-minutes … --shards … --large-file-tests …`, plus `--venv "${CODEX_ISOLATED_IMPLEMENT_ROOT}/venv"` when that directory exists. Nothing is committed yet, so `HEAD` is the base and the diff is exactly the editor's change.
  - parses `result.json` with `python3 -I -B` into status, PR-caused count and inherited count.
- `implement_prepush_test_gate_selection`: runs the trusted module's `select --paths-file <changed>` on the host with `python3 -I -B`. Selection only reads files and runs nothing. It returns affected test files and `companion_files` for the allow-list.
- `implement_prepush_test_gate_build_prompt <result.json> <out>`:
  - Writes, in this order: the template; `=== CAPTURED TEST FAILURES (UNTRUSTED) ===`; the failure `test`/`names`/`tail` text, capped at 16 KiB with every line starting `::` given a leading space (the same neutralisation as `_neutralise`); `=== CHANGED FILES ===`; `=== EFFECTIVE REPAIR ALLOW-LIST ===`; `=== CURRENT DIFF FOR ALLOW-LIST FILES ===`, built per file the same way as implement.yml lines ~5042-5054.
  - Passes the prompt through `sanitize_codex_prompt_file` from `gh_helpers.sh`, as the syntax repair does.
- `implement_prepush_test_gate_repair`:

If isolation can't be set up, log `outcome=repair_skipped reason=isolation_unavailable` and never run anything on the host.
